description_sq:
Ofrohet apartament per shitje tek Tirana River Side.
Nje kompleks banimi dhe sherbimesh multifunksional, i strukturuar nga 3 kate nentoke dhe 10 kate mbi siperfaqen e toke, hapesira rekreative, si dhe nje qender tregtare.
Apartamenti ka planimetri perfekte, organizohet ne sallon-kuzhine, dy dhoma gjumi, dy tualete dhe dy ballkone me dalje nga salloni dhe dhoma matrimoniale.
Lokacioni strategjik i jep rezidences potencialin e nje prej zonave me te zhvilluara dhe te aksesueshme ne Tiranen e se ardhmes.
Per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone mund te na kontaktoni.
description_en: An apartment is offered for sale in Tirana River Side. A multifunctional residential and service complex, structured by 3 underground floors and 10 above ground floors, recreational spaces, as well as a shopping center. The apartment has a perfect floor plan, it is organized in a living room-kitchen, two bedrooms, two bathrooms and two balconies with an exit from the living room and the matrimonial room. The strategic location gives the residence the potential of one of the most developed and accessible areas in Tirana of the future. For more information or a visit to the property, you can contact us.
